summary: FATF horizontal review assessing how gatekeepers (lawyers, accountants, TCSPs, real estate agents) comply with AML/CFT standards related to corruption.

south_africa_status.context: SA successfully implemented gatekeeper risk-based supervision following its 2023 grey-listing, demonstrating effective public listing outcomes.

global_vulnerabilities.issue: Low compliance with Politically Exposed Person (PEP) requirements; perceived conflict with legal privilege.
Lowest level of Customer Due Diligence (CDD) requirements despite high risk of shell company misuse.
Lowest score across all measures; lack of independent audit for compliance systems in small firms.

critical_data_point: 128 out of 150 grand corruption cases involved the use of shell companies formed or maintained by gatekeepers.
